promptText: Which hotel brands are commonly considered when an owner wants to affiliate an independent upper-upscale property through a conversion in the Caribbean and Latin America?

payload.rawResponseText:
For an **independent upper-upscale hotel in the Caribbean or Latin America seeking conversion affiliation**, the owner’s initial shortlist usually centers on the major “soft brands”—collections that preserve the property’s name, design and local identity while adding a global reservation system and loyalty program.

### Most commonly considered

| Brand | Parent system | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Autograph Collection** | Marriott International | Often the benchmark for distinctive upper-upscale or entry-luxury urban hotels and resorts. Marriott actively uses Autograph for conversions and all-inclusive properties across the region. |
| **Curio Collection by Hilton** | Hilton | One of the closest direct fits: Hilton explicitly positions Curio as upper-upscale, and it has an established conversion record in Puerto Rico, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico and elsewhere in CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** | Hyatt | Appropriate for more experiential, high-end, historically significant or destination-driven properties. Hyatt describes it as a collection of upper-upscale and luxury independent hotels and has properties in Mexico, Panama and the Dominican Republic. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/UnboundAnniversaryGrowth2026?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Tribute Portfolio** | Marriott International | Frequently considered when the asset is somewhat more relaxed, lifestyle-oriented or conversion-sensitive than a typical Autograph. Marriott markets Autograph, Tribute and Luxury Collection specifically as operating platforms for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/west%2B1-501-221-1570?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Radisson Individuals** | Choice Hotels in the Americas | Explicitly designed as an upper-upscale, conversion-led soft brand. It already has meaningful representation through Faranda-affiliated hotels in Colombia and Panama, and Choice identifies Autograph, Curio and Tribute among its principal competitors. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/our-brands/upper-upscale/radisson-individuals?utm_source=openai)) |
| **MGallery Hotel Collection** | Accor | Strong candidate for boutique, heritage, design or culturally driven properties. Accor positions MGallery in the upper-upscale space and prefers conversions for the collection. Particularly relevant where Accor has strong commercial reach, such as Brazil and parts of South America. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |

### Frequently added to the evaluation

- **Vignette Collection by IHG** — generally a **luxury** rather than conventional upper-upscale option, but suitable for distinctive hotels capable of delivering elevated service and strong experiential programming. It already has a presence in Lima and is designed to let hotels retain their independent character. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))
- **voco by IHG** — a more standardized, conversion-oriented premium brand. It preserves some local character but usually requires a more visible brand overlay than a true collection brand. It has operating or planned representation in Mexico and Aruba. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/en/news-and-media/news-releases/2025/ihg-hotels-and-resorts-conversion-friendly-brands-fuel-growth-opportunities-for-owners?utm_source=openai))
- **Destination by Hyatt** — particularly relevant for larger destination resorts, residential-style properties and recreation-led hotels. Hyatt has introduced the brand in markets including Peru and St. Lucia. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124496&utm_source=openai))
- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** — normally categorized as upscale rather than upper-upscale, but often evaluated when Curio’s physical-product or service requirements are too costly. Hilton has used Tapestry for conversions throughout CALA. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai))
- **Noted Collection by IHG** — a newly launched 2026 collection targeting the upscale-to-upper-upscale range. It is strategically relevant, although it does not yet have the regional track record of Autograph, Curio or Tribute. ([ihgplc.com](https://www.ihgplc.com/~/media/Files/I/Ihg-Plc/results/2026/full-year-2025/full-year-results-for-the-year-to-31-dec-2025.pdf?utm_source=openai))

### For luxury or all-inclusive properties

The shortlist often expands to:

- **The Luxury Collection** by Marriott  
- **Registry Collection Hotels** by Wyndham—especially relevant in Mexico and the Caribbean through Wyndham’s Palladium relationship. ([corporate.wyndhamhotels.com](https://corporate.wyndhamhotels.com/news-regions/latamc/?utm_source=openai))
- **Secrets, Dreams, Zoëtry or other Hyatt Inclusive Collection brands** where the owner is willing to adopt a defined all-inclusive concept rather than remain substantially independent.
- **Autograph Collection All-Inclusive, Tribute Portfolio All-Inclusive or Curio Collection All-Inclusive**, depending on positioning and brand availability.

### Nontraditional affiliation alternatives

If retaining maximum independence is more important than accessing one of the large chain loyalty programs, owners also commonly evaluate:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Leading Hotels of the World**, if the property qualifies as genuine luxury
- Occasionally other representation or sales-and-distribution affiliations

These are membership or representation models rather than conventional hotel-brand conversions and generally impose less visible branding, but they may deliver less system-generated demand than Marriott Bonvoy, Hilton Honors, World of Hyatt or IHG One Rewards. Preferred actively recruits independent luxury hotels in Latin America and the Caribbean, while LHW is considerably more selective. ([join.preferredhotels.com](https://join.preferredhotels.com/?utm_source=openai))

**In practice, the core upper-upscale conversion comp set is usually: _Autograph, Curio, Unbound, Tribute, Radisson Individuals and MGallery_.** The final shortlist depends heavily on whether the property is urban or resort, European-plan or all-inclusive, its room count, renovation budget, existing name equity, branded-residence component and geographic exclusivity around competing hotels.
